text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hellooo... and,
oh, Trainer!
What book are you reading?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm just rereading something I read before.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ooh... Um, could I borrow that later? I want to include a Trainer character in my manga, so I'd love to use it as reference!
choice_data_list: Oh, sure! I'll lend it to you right away.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"'What a person says they're aiming for may not necessarily be what they truly envision.
You must observe them closely in daily training'—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see! I might be able to use this part!
Taking notes, taking notes...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
Wait, is this place... kind of...?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Here's the plan for the next race!
This is totally gonna make a huge impact, right!?
choice_data_list: ...Is this really what you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh? Yes... that is true, but?
choice_data_list: ...Could it be that this isn't the real essence?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...! Amazing! Trainer-san's
research materials! Yes! Right here, this is it!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh, how did you know!?
What I wanted to do!
Are you psychic!? Have ESP!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Is it because...
you've been watching me all this time...?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa, I get it now!
Oh, the answer is so simple!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I want to know more!
About what's going on inside your head, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Kiseki absorbed everything she had been taught
and bloomed all at once—
putting on a magnificent run.
